text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for agreeing to attend my
birthday
party.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
This will be my way of giving back to
you. So
please, enjoy tonight.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, thank you for inviting me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In case there's anything you're unsure
about, I
know my way around the venue,
so don't hesitate
to ask.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah, even a birthday party isn't safe
from your
power grabs. Kris S is the host,
not you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Sorry, it's a bad habit of
mine. I
will enjoy tonight as a guest and
nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please look forward to it. Thanks to
Sirius's
help, everything is in order.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Tch. Quiet. You don't have to tell her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Please do, I'd love to hear more.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
She handled everything I was unsure
about. She's
even going to pilot the
surprise airplane.
